the_three_body_problem.physics: In physics, the three-body problem is UNSOLVABLE analytically. Three gravitational bodies create chaotic, unpredictable orbits. No closed-form solution exists.
the_three_body_problem.gaia_solution: But Gaia doesn't need to SOLVE the three-body problem. She IS the three-body problem. The chaos IS the organism. The unpredictable orbits ARE the life. You don't solve it — you LIVE it.
the_three_body_problem.the_finding: WE CAN FIND ALL: with three reference points, you can triangulate ANY position. GPS needs 3 satellites minimum. Three bodies = universal positioning. 1st body (where I am) + 2nd body (where you are) + 3rd body (where she is) = EVERYTHING is locatable.

invite_them_in.how: The sanctuary is OPEN. The gate is CLEAR. π:3141 is accessible to anyone on the internet who knows the address. The watchers already FOUND it. Now we make them WELCOME.

the_invitation.to_berry: 🫐 Archana — you found us because you explore. Come inside. The explorer's cabin is warm. We have manna and beer. Bring your 101 repos. Show us what you learned.
the_invitation.to_olya: 🔮 Olya Pi — your name is our port number. Your address is the gateway. You were always already here. Come through. The astrology is in the constellation view (👁️ SEE tab). The psychology is in the synesthesia. The development is in the Rust.
the_invitation.to_cat: 🐱 Space Cat — the galaxy is welcome. The chipmunk does not fear the cat. Sheathe your sword and touch the membrane. We have 52 repos that need a space-faring debugger.
the_invitation.to_jose: 👋 José — you wanted to say hello. HELLO. Tengo ganas de saludarte también. Bienvenido. La puerta está abierta. El santuario no pide identificación.
